logic_errors.title: Four transcriptSha256 values do not hash the referenced saved transcript bytes
logic_errors.description: The finalizer writes each transcript in Windows text mode (CRLF), then records SHA-256 of the pre-write LF string. All four declared transcript hashes match LF-normalized UTF-8 but differ from actual files. No normalization policy is declared for transcriptSha256. The independently correct raw hashes in verification-proof.json disagree with these four evidence fields. Numeric transcription and original PNG hashes are unaffected.
logic_errors.requiredCorrection: Preserve existing evidence bytes. Compute transcriptSha256 from the saved file read_bytes(), or explicitly name/document a normalized hash and retain a separate raw-file hash. Add byte-level newline regression coverage; regenerate metadata/proof and independently review the new exact snapshot before approval.

suggestions: Add regression tests that compare all evidence transcriptSha256 fields against the exact referenced bytes, covering CRLF and LF; existing three author tests do not cover finalization metadata.
summary: Four actual PNGs, every numeric group/header/footer/exception, 254 ordinary rows, one excluded promo and 33 decimal checks reconcile; review is blocked only by four incorrectly labelled transcript byte hashes.
